performance.summary: Story-level roll-up for multi-plant (All plants in the MIS statement). Both tasks shipped with their own clean three-lens pass: all-plants-statement-ui (PR #60, 10/10/10) and all-plants-backend (PR #61, quality 10, performance 9 approve-with-caveats, security 10), followed by the dependent-selector lite window Q-0045-5e5b (PR #62, four rounds, 10/10/10 at 25bbd92) and this closeout window's prettier-only fix. No shipped code is re-reviewed here; all three performance passes finished with zero blocking findings. Two P2 caveats from the backend pass are carried, not fixed: ownership is checked after executeBlock has already run the full projection for a non-owner statement, and the statement service fetches the complete outline twice per statement while using only the batch id of the second fetch. Both are static observations on a 31-plant, single-month dataset; neither changed a measured number.
